liquidityVacuumAmplifier.identificationNote: Profile likelihood does not distinguish this amplifier from no amplification at the 5% reference cutoff; use its sensitivity range, not as established evidence.

liquidityInputs.pathConstruction: historical template composite, scaled/capped by scenario class

commonDrawDesign.interpretation: lane-conditional draws; not the core's 10,000 row-wise joint country draws

method.edgeEstimator: sign-shrunk local projections with HAC errors; selected horizon maximises absolute t-statistic within prespecified lag range
limitations: Conditional class paths use paired DrawBundle innovations within the contagion lane; the API is not yet wired to the US, China, or joint core path objects.
Monthly SOFR-IORB, Treasury-volatility, TGA, and ON RRP paths are not simulated; the liquidity amplifier uses a proxy composite and historical templates.
EM sovereign and commodities nodes have no observed proxy series and are prior/edge driven.
China proxies are quarterly BIS private snapshots and cannot identify monthly transmission or joint tail dependence.
Five edges are prior-only; weak channels remain explicitly unestimated.

tolerance.metric: mean absolute error of peak node stress over scored nodes, node-index SD units

method.tailDependence: empirical lower-tail diagnostics with moving-block bootstrap; diagnostics do not identify cross-region copula structure
